shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੰਦ ਲਾਲ ਸੁਨ ਆਪ ਲੰਗਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਹੀ ਹਮ॥
verses.translit_en: na(n)dh laal sun aap la(n)gar kee bidh kahee ham||

en.bdb: Nand Lal, You've listened to the Maryada of Langar which I have relayed to you.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੇ ਬਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਜੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਂ ਕਰਾਵਤੇ॥੧੫੨॥
verses.translit_en: hove badd prataap ju bidh so(n) karaavate||152||

en.bdb: One will gain immense glory who does it in this way.
